scenes.title: One plan. Clear responsibilities.
scenes.speaker: Julius
scenes.text: ChargeWise turns a fleet roster into a checked charging plan. A React dashboard talks to FastAPI. Scheduling runs on the CPU. NVIDIA Nemotron is a separate inference service on Nebius Token Factory.

scenes.title: Validate before changing state.
scenes.speaker: Julius
scenes.text: Sessions, prices and charger settings enter through one validation boundary. Pandas and typed models check fields, times and physical limits. Only a complete valid scenario replaces the browser's versioned, in memory workspace.

scenes.title: Power is assigned to physical plugs.
scenes.speaker: Talha
scenes.text: The scheduler allocates power to vehicles and plugs across time. It respects site capacity, individual charger ratings, fixed occupancy, battery limits, efficiency and conservative taper. Delivered energy is power integrated over time.

scenes.title: Compare fairly. Optimize in order.
scenes.speaker: Talha
scenes.text: First come first served, earliest deadline first and least laxity first use the same constraints. OR Tools minimizes unserved energy first, then energy plus demand cost. An alternative objective minimizes peak before cost.

scenes.title: A candidate must pass an independent check.
scenes.speaker: Talha
scenes.text: Solver output passes through an independent validator. It checks allocations against the inputs and completed delivery. Checked plans feed metrics and the dashboard. A feasible schedule and a proven optimum remain distinct claims.

scenes.title: The model proposes. Tools enforce.
scenes.speaker: Umar Khan
scenes.text: Natural language follows a separate tool loop. The server reserves an inference allowance, then calls Nemotron on Nebius. Returned arguments pass typed validation and a permission gate. Approved actions use the same planner and validator. The model explains computed facts.

scenes.title: Replan the future. Preserve the past.
scenes.speaker: Umar Khan
scenes.text: An outage or price change updates the constraints. Completed delivery stays frozen. The planner recalculates future allocations and streams actual progress. Event identifiers prevent duplicate changes; version checks reject stale edits.

scenes.title: Capacity is a separate, inspectable study.
scenes.speaker: Umar Khan
scenes.text: The capacity study asks which installed plugs and shared power can serve the roster. A physical lower bound and a feasible checked schedule can prove a minimum. An unfinished search remains unresolved.

scenes.title: Runtime and experiments stay explicit.
scenes.speaker: Julius
scenes.text: The interface and CPU backend form one application. Model inference runs on Nebius. Times F M and Chronos remain offline forecasting experiments. No physical charger is controlled. Next, the live walkthrough shows the operator workflow.
